title: agsc.config.json
description: The single configuration file of a Bundle (AGSC-01-17). Configuration is CLOSED: additionalProperties is false and an unknown top-level key is error AGSC-E004 (AGSC-01-18), except the x-<vendor>-<key> forward-compatibility namespace (docs/SPEC.md §8(2)), admitted by patternProperties and preserved verbatim. There is no second configuration file. CC0-1.0.

base.description: Absolute https origin, trailing slash optional and stripped; the IRI base of every item (AGSC-01-19). The development placeholder http://localhost[:port]/ written by adoption (AGSC-02-94) is accepted and lint-warned as AGSC-E506 until the owner sets a real base (D52(1)).

analytics_token.description: Edge analytics token only. No beacon, cookie or third-party script may be emitted (AGSC-06-05).

base.description: Vocabulary hash namespace; the site domain MUST NOT appear here (AGSC-05-02).

releases.description: Boolean switchboard; an item with release: <key> publishes only when its key is true (AGSC-01-20).

allowed.description: The closed tag vocabulary; a tag outside it is AGSC-E203 (AGSC-01-21).

out.description: Build output directory; default www, a trailing slash is accepted and stripped (AGSC-01-19).

rdfxml.description: Emit /graph.rdf; default false. RDF/XML stays inside v1.0 per D49: when true the view MUST be emitted (AGSC-05-06, AGSC-06-01).

default.description: BCP 47 tag of the primary (unsuffixed) files; default en.

peers.description: Federation peers (AGSC-10-12): each entry is another node's canonical /.well-known/knowledge-linkset URL, emitted as one .../rel#peer link in the link set (AGSC-06-10).

run.description: Opt-in execution settings for the run and trace verbs (AGSC-09-94). Both verbs exit 2 with AGSC-E001 unless enabled is true.

allow.description: Program names permitted as the first word of a {run} block; anything else is refused.

channels.description: Registered ingest channels (AGSC-01-30..33). allow[] and rate{per_hour} are the only keys admitted after the 1.0.0-rc.2 freeze (D61(3)). name is unique; author is the forge identity CI checks the PR author against, owner is the accountable human whose publish choice AGSC-08-26 treats as standing approval (D52(4)).

author.description: Forge login of the identity that opens ingest pull requests (AGSC-08-26 c).

publish.description: Default hitl; auto merges only under AGSC-08-26.

allow.description: OPTIONAL sender allow-list: the ingest job rejects a message whose sender is absent from a non-empty list; an absent or empty array accepts every sender (AGSC-01-30, D61(3)).

per_hour.description: Maximum messages ingested from this channel per hour; the job stops for the hour at the bound and records the skipped messages by sources[].id (AGSC-01-33).

injection_patterns.description: Literal alternations only, never user-supplied regular expressions (AGSC-08-14).

federation.description: AGSC-11-01/11-06/11-09 walk parameters; defaults hop_limit 3, fan_out 50, max_requests 500, redirect_limit 3, timeout_ms 10000; any value up to the maximum is admitted (AGSC-E209 beyond it).

chunks.description: AGSC-11-01; chunk export bound (rules in §06 at rc.3).

contribute.description: AGSC-11-14 contribute targets published as rel#contribute links; the mode fixes the target form (oneOf). A node's own configuration is closed (AGSC-11-02 tolerance applies to received documents only).

visibility.description: AGSC-11-20. Closed for a node's own configuration; the AGSC-11-02 most-restrictive reading (restricted) applies only to a discovery document a reader did not author.

human_actor.description: AGSC-01-25: the accountable operator of this Bundle, human:<id> only; the first source of prov.operator at adoption (AGSC-02-90).
